title: Small Moves Lead to Massive Shifts: Compounding
summary: Applies the principle of compound interest beyond finance, demonstrating how small, consistent daily efforts accumulate exponentially across skill development, relationships, and fitness—contrasting sustained incremental progress against infrequent large efforts.
when-to-read: Read this when you're questioning whether small daily efforts matter, or when you need motivation to maintain consistent practice on long-term goals. If you're looking for specific time-management techniques or sprint-based productivity methods, consult decision-making or engineering-management resources instead.
